goal: density, Tg and bulk modulus for polyethylene (achiral), stereo_r2

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PHYC.ff_note: TraPPE-UA via EMC: purely apolar C/H backbone (charge <0.1 e), which qualifies for the lj/cut-only routing tier -- PCFF/OPLS-AA's PPPM machinery is unnecessary and TraPPE-UA is far cheaper per atom. Ramos2015: PE Tg=187K vs exp 185-195K, density within +/-7% -- directly validated. Branched types (PP, PIB) have UA parameters but no published polymer-Tg validation; treat with medium confidence until confirmed. TraPPE-UA's own founding paper (Martin & Siepmann 1998) validates only C1-C12 n-alkane VLE/critical-point data via Monte Carlo -- PE's confidence rests on the downstream Ramos2015 MD validation, not the 1998 origin paper.
PE: 2 chains × 300 repeat units; COMPASS; NVT 300 K + NPT 300 K; cooling 300→100 K in 10 K/200 ps steps; Tg ~200 K vs literature 195 K.
evidence.citation: The glass transition temperature measurements of polyethylene: determined by using molecular dynamic method. RSC Advances, 2016.

evidence.claim: High-throughput GAFF2 polymer MD; 1 ns NVT anneal 300→700 K; 10 chains ~10,000 atoms; LAMMPS; systematic Tg and density for 1070+ polymers. Primary reference for nchain, dp, and forcefield defaults.
evidence.citation: Hayashi, Y. et al. RadonPy: Automated Physical Property Calculation using All-atom Classical Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Polymer Informatics. npj Comput. Mater. 2022, 8, 222.

evidence.claim: Tg values for 12 polymers; PE Tg=281±52 K; PDMS Tg ~228 K. Validation data for PHYC and PSIL classes.
evidence.citation: Srivastava, A. et al. On-the-Fly Machine-Learned Force Fields for High-Fidelity Polymer Glass Transition Simulations. arXiv:2601.17137.

evidence.claim: OPLS3e GPU-based Tg for 315 polymers; validates electrostatics impact on polar vs apolar polymers. lj/cut acceptable only when backbone charge < 0.1 e.
evidence.citation: Afzal, M. A. F. et al. High-Throughput Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Validation of Thermophysical Properties of Polymers for Various Applications. ACS Appl. Polym. Mater. 2021, 3, 2, 620–630.

evidence.claim: Original TraPPE-UA force field for n-alkanes (CH3/CH2 united atoms): LJ parameters fitted to vapor–liquid coexistence of C1–C12 alkanes. Foundation for all TraPPE-UA-routed classes (PHYC, PDIE) via EMC.
evidence.citation: Martin, M. G.; Siepmann, J. I. Transferable Potentials for Phase Equilibria. 1. United-Atom Description of n-Alkanes. J. Phys. Chem. B 1998, 102, 2569–2577.

evidence.claim: PE TraPPE-UA MD: Tg=187 K, excellent agreement with extrapolated experimental Tg(U)~195 K (Boyer 1973). Characteristic ratio C_n=8.2 at 500 K. Justifies ff_accuracy_prior=trappe-ua for PHYC/PDIE and sets ff_justification_doi for those classes.
evidence.citation: Ramos, J.; Vega, J. F.; Martínez-Salazar, J. Molecular Dynamics Simulations for the Description of Experimental Molecular Conformation, Melt Dynamics, and Phase Transitions in Polyethylene. Macromolecules 2015, 48, 5016–5027.

evidence.claim: Experimental review establishing two PE glass transitions: Tg(L)~145 K (dangling cilia/tight folds in crystalline PE) and Tg(U)~195 K (loose loops/tie molecules, amorphous regions). Amorphous-cell simulations target Tg(U)~195 K. Primary experimental reference for PHYC class PE Tg.
evidence.citation: Boyer, R. F. Glass Temperatures of Polyethylene. Macromolecules 1973, 6, 288.

No EMC trial build was run, so coverage is asserted from polymer_rules.json:classes.PHYC.ff_accuracy_prior='trappe-ua' only; whether 'trappe-ua' can type THIS repeat unit is unverified until the build stage runs.
